svg.title: NVL72 rack: 72 GPUs acting as one logical GPU
svg.text: The NVL72 rack: 72 GPUs acting as one logical GPU
NVLink 5.0 fabric plus 9 NVSwitch boards fuse 72 Blackwell GPUs into one machine.
After: one rack, one logical GPU
At this scale the rack is the computer. The data center is racks wired together.
Source: original plate. Numbers from the chapter ([Added 2026] ModulEdge explainer).
